cues: As the cell runs, zinc ions pile up and copper ions are used, so Q rises, and the E M F slowly falls.
Run it long enough, and Q reaches K, the E M F reaches zero, and the battery is flat.
text: Watch the Daniell cell. As the cell runs, zinc ions pile up and copper ions are used, so Q rises, and the E M F slowly falls. Run it long enough, and Q reaches K, the E M F reaches zero, and the battery is flat.
